topic: How does defocused feed array placement optimize coverage versus scan loss in DBF architectures?
consensus_response: Defocused feed array placement optimizes coverage by reducing scan loss, which increases with beam steering. This trade-off affects network capacity and service availability. Increasing elements minimizes scan loss but introduces complexity and interference, while beamforming algorithms mitigate element failure and interference, optimizing coverage.
reference_context: Defocused feed arrays reduce taper and spillover loss, with average unit cell loss impacting budget and system performance.
